rule.name: min_extension
rule.definition: Entry also requires the signal-bar close to be at least 0.10 x the band half-width (band_mult x sigma x raw session open) beyond the band: long close - upper >= 0.10*half, short lower - close >= 0.10*half. Everything else is #1 unchanged; re-arming is unchanged.

chosen_on: 2018-2024 only (dev + validation), from a 16-variant exploratory sweep on 2026-11-24; threshold plateau 0.05-0.20. Holdout of #1 itself was inspected before (2026-11-02), so this is NOT an untouched test.
pass_criteria_preregistered: variant holdout Sharpe >= baseline #1 holdout Sharpe (same run, same data)
variant holdout profit factor >= baseline #1 holdout profit factor
variant holdout net return > 0 and Sharpe >= 0 (the funnel's holdout acceptance)
